summary: Biscuit, your friendly apricot goldendoodle with curly coat and red collar, slipped her lead around 5:30 and has been caught on camera twice — drinking at the Dog park water fountain in Plymouth at 5:42 PM and then lingering for 12 seconds at the Neighbour's doorbell on Elm St car park at 6:18 PM — so I've recorded an urgent search plan to focus on foot around the Elm St car park and quiet side streets tonight avoiding traffic which scares her, checking under cars and doorways with treats and asking locals for doorbell footage, and I've also generated a shareable LOST DOG poster with her photo and last-seen locations to spread immediately.
